about.biography: I am a Full-stack Developer with a strong interest in backend architecture and Web3 technologies. Experienced in designing efficient APIs, managing large-scale relational databases, and building smart contract-based decentralized applications (dApps).

items.company: Artificial Intelligence Literacy and Innovation Institute (ALII)
items.description: Built backend architecture using Python and FastAPI to support a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for academic document analysis. Integrated Large Language Models (LLMs) into the data processing pipeline to efficiently extract structured information from student thesis drafts.

Built, optimized, and maintained custom web applications for various clients using the Laravel and Next.js ecosystems. Focused on writing clean code, efficient database architectures, and responsive interfaces.

items.details: Currently in my 7th semester with a keen interest in Software Engineering, Web Development, Database Architecture, and System Security. Actively involved in various application development projects in both academic and professional environments.
